messages:
Maria R: Heads-up — Acme ERP says procurement will only accept Adobe Sign for their POC order. They also redlined the MSA: want SLA in §6.2 changed to 99.5% for the POC. Need legal + finance ok before I push Order Form. cc @Tara Law @Josh Finn

Pete L: Quick Q — what exactly is the POC scope (length, seats, infra)? helps size risk/ops work.

Maria R: POC: 3 months, up to 5 dev seats, non-prod data only. They want a 4hr P1 response time in the SOW (we standard 1hr for enterprise). They asked we sign a ‘trial order form’ at $0 but procurement insists on full Order Form flow.

Tara Law: Looped in. We shouldn't change MSA SLA globally for POC. Propose a POC amendment: carve out 'no production use', set SLA to 'best effort' or included reduced SLA only in the SOW, and cap liability for POC. Also need to review their DPA redlines — they added a data export/return clause that is broader than usual.

Josh Finn: From finance: if we go with Adobe Sign + reduced SLA we need exec approval for the discount/terms since this changes commercial risk. Also confirm whether $0 order forms still require PO numbers on their side — impacts billing records.

Maria R: They will supply PO# even for $0. I suggested `order_form.amount = 0` + `order_form.note = "POC - subject to MSA"` but procurement still wants standard routing.

Kevin Ops: FYI our esign integration supports Adobe Sign but it triggers different webhook auth and a short provisioning step. PS needs to provision Adobe connector for the account. That’s ~2 business days. @Esme PS can confirm.

Esme PS: I can spin up the Adobe Sign connector and run test flow. Need a signed MSA or at least countersigned POC amendment before provisioning any private connectors. If legal ok with the carve-out I can schedule provisioning next Wed.

Tara Law: Drafting POC amendment now. Plan: (1) explicit "POC — no production use" clause; (2) limited SLA for POC with specific targets and escalation path; (3) liability cap for POC (suggest $10k); (4) limited DPA scope & subprocessors list request. Will ask Acme to accept amendment instead of editing master MSA.

Maria R: Action items for this thread: 1) @Tara Law — send draft amendment in thread, 2) @Esme PS — confirm provisioning ETA, 3) @Josh Finn — confirm if exec approval needed for POC terms/discount, 4) I'll ask Acme for their subprocessors list and Adobe Sign admin contact. Will escalate to CRO if any blocker by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

Acme Procurement Bot: Acme Procurement: we can accept a POC carve-out but Adobe Sign is mandatory per policy. We will accept a business-continuity paragraph in the SOW; please provide amendment and a list of subprocessors. Contact: procurement@acme.example

Tara Law: Thanks — I'll include a minimal business continuity clause (notification, mitigation steps, no SLA guarantee for POC) and attach the draft amendment here when ready.

Maria R: Perfect — thanks everyone. Keeping this open until we get countersign. If legal or finance veto, I'll route to CRO. :eyes:
